posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Cosmic Contest wasn't really a story about "In Space" though.  He was in an arena that happened to not be on Earth, and then he wasn't anymore.

Golden Age Captain Cosmic was easily my favorite part of this story, I was hoping we'd learn more about him at some point.

We also learned the name of the singular entity of Passion ("The Fervor") and that there are several more singular entities out there.

And perhaps most importantly, we learned about a bunch of spoileriffic stuff that they'll answer in the Scion episode, if we ask.
